text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria and the European Union start talks on Tuesday on a trade accord with the 15-nation bloc.

- Population growth rate drops to 1.9 percent in 1995 after hovering at more than 3.0 percent in the 1980s. The change was due mainly to better education as well as a shortage of houses forcing young people to delay marriages.
- The Transitional National Council votes privatisation and election laws.
- The newly voted privatisation law needs changes in the future. Industry Minister Abdesalam Bouchareb hinted recently that the privatisation legislation had still to be improved.
- Said Saadi, leader of the Rally for Democracy and Culture (RCD) party, says foreign observers to supervise Algeria's upcoming general elections would guarantee credibility for the poll.
